description: This file defines a Java interface 'ConnectionFactory' for creating AMQP 1.0 connections in the Eclipse Hono project. It declares methods for connection management, including connecting with or without authentication and retrieving connection parameters.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: A Java interface for creating and managing AMQP 1.0 connections, providing methods to connect and retrieve connection parameters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container-id name used in the client's AMQP Open frame, or null if not set.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address of the server to which connections are created.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the server.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character separator used for path components in target addresses.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server with specified options, handlers for close and disconnect events, and a callback for the result. Overloaded to include authentication parameters.
